chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, all from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When a man marries the girl and she is young, he should not enter into her (consummate the marriage) until nine years come to her.
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum age for consummating marriage in Shia jurisprudence according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the minimum age for consummation at nine years, a foundational ruling in Shia jurisprudence derived from the concept of 'bulugh' (maturity) in this context. It highlights the distinction between the contract of marriage (nikah), which can occur earlier, and the physical union (dakhil), which is deferred until the girl reaches this specific age threshold.
